script_model_with_instances: script a detectron2 model using scripting_with_instances to export a TorchScript model with static Instances fields
export_torchscript_with_instances: export a detectron2 model in evaluation mode to TorchScript format using the export_torchscript_with_instances alias
dump_torchscript_IR: dump the IR of a TorchScript model to a directory with code, graph, and inlined graph files
script_model_with_boxes_and_logits: script a model with proposal_boxes and objectness_logits fields using scripting_with_instances for TorchScript export
inspect_torchscript_model_code: inspect and dump pretty-printed code of a scripted or traced TorchScript model to a text file
